Build packages in the workspace

Builds the named packages, or every package in the workspace when none is named.
Outputs go under the target directory; a package whose inputs have not changed
since its last build is not rebuilt.

ESC[1;4mArguments:ESC[0m
  ESC[38;2;87;118;124m[<packages>...]ESC[0m  Packages to build (default: every package)

ESC[1;4mOptions:ESC[0m

                                 [env: DEPOT_JOBS]

      ESC[1;33m--target-dirESC[0m ESC[38;2;87;118;124m<DIR>ESC[0m         Directory for build outputs [default: target]

  ESC[1;33m-hESC[0m, ESC[1;33m--helpESC[0m                     Print help

ESC[1;4mExamples:ESC[0m
